verses.ar:
طَلَعَ الْبَدْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ مِنْ ثَنِيَّاتِ الْوَدَاعْ
وَجَبَ الشُّكْرُ عَلَيْنَا ۞ مَا دَعَا لِلّٰهِ دَاعْ
verses.tr: Ṭalaʿa-l-badru ʿalaynā · min thaniyyāti-l-wadāʿ · Wajaba-sh-shukru ʿalaynā · mā daʿā lillāhi dāʿ
verses.en: The full moon has risen over us from the valley of Wada — gratitude is due from us for as long as any caller calls to Allah.

verses.ar: أَيُّهَا الْمَبْعُوثُ فِينَا ۞ جِئْتَ بِالْأَمْرِ الْمُطَاعْ
verses.en: O you who were sent among us, you came with a command to be obeyed.

verses.ar: كُنْ شَفِيعًا يَا حَبِيبِي ۞ يَوْمَ حَشْرٍ وَاجْتِمَاعْ
verses.tr: Kun shafīʿan yā ḥabībī · yawma ḥashrin wa-jtimāʿ
verses.en: Be our intercessor, O my beloved, on the day of gathering and assembly.

verses.ar: رَبَّنَا صَلِّ عَلٰى مَنْ ۞ حَلَّ فِي خَيْرِ الْبِقَاعْ
verses.tr: Rabbanā ṣalli ʿalā man · ḥalla fī khayri-l-biqāʿ
verses.en: Our Lord, send blessings upon the one who came to dwell in the best of lands.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ غَوْثُنَا جَمِيعًا ۞ يَا مُجَمَّلَ الطِّبَاعْ
verses.en: You are the refuge of us all, O you of perfected character.

verses.ar: وَلَبِسْنَا ثَوْبَ عِزٍّ ۞ بَعْدَ تَلْفِيقِ الرِّقَاعْ
verses.tr: Wa labisnā thawba ʿizzin · baʿda talfīqi-r-riqāʿ
verses.en: Through you we put on the robe of honor after wearing stitched-together rags.

verses.ar: أَسْبِلِ السِّتْرَ عَلَيْنَا ۞ يَا مُجِيبًا كُلَّ دَاعْ
verses.tr: Asbili-s-sitra ʿalaynā · yā mujīban kulla dāʿ
verses.en: Let the veil of covering fall over our faults, O Answerer of every caller.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ عَلٰى أَحْمَدْ ۞ عَدَّ تَحْرِيرِ الرِّقَاعْ
verses.tr: Wa ṣalātullāhi ʿalā Aḥmad · ʿadda taḥrīri-r-riqāʿ
verses.en: And Allah's blessings upon Ahmad, as many as all the pages ever penned.

verses.ar: وَكَذَا آلٍ وَصَحْبٍ ۞ مَا سَعَى لِلّٰهِ سَاعْ
verses.tr: Wa kadhā ālin wa ṣaḥbin · mā saʿā lillāhi sāʿ
verses.en: And likewise upon his family and companions, for as long as any striver strives for Allah.
